entities.summary: Franz Sedlacek was an Austrian painter who belonged to the tradition known as "New Objectivity", an artistic movement similar to Magical Realism. At the end of the Second World War he "disappeared" as a soldier of the Wehrmacht near Toruń, Poland. He was declared missing on February 1, 1945 and pronounced dead in 1972.
